summary: Gmail's Smart Compose predicts text as you type and Smart Reply suggests short responses. Both can be turned off individually from Gmail settings without disabling other features.

steps.path: Gmail → gear icon → See all settings → General → scroll to Smart Compose → select 'Smart Compose off'
Same page → Smart Compose personalization → uncheck to stop Google using your writing style for predictions
Same page → Smart Reply → select 'Smart Reply off'

regionNotes: Smart Compose and Smart Reply are off by default in the EEA, UK, Switzerland and Japan.
whyTheyDidIt: Google wants AI to feel indispensable in everyday email, normalizing AI-assisted writing.

sources.label: Google Help — Use Smart Compose in Gmail
Consumer Reports — How to Turn Off AI Tools

alternatives.name: Fastmail
alternatives.why: no AI compose or reply, paid email with privacy focus
